features: Expandable subject-wise details view implemented in frontend.
Fallback state 'No official university result data available for this semester.' correctly implemented.
Dropdown mapping for assigned CTPO year correctly drives semester options.
scope_findings: Backend (ctpoCore.controller.js) correctly restricts students by branchId and year based on getCtpoScope().
Section restriction is NOT enforced in ctpoCore.controller.js, correctly allowing the CTPO to see the entire cohort as requested.
However, semesterResult.controller.js has a duplicate getResults that incorrectly forces a sectionId restriction for CTPO, though it is not actively hit by this frontend module.
data_source_findings: Strictly uses the official SemesterResult collection.
Does NOT fabricate records or assume default passing/backlog states.
Grade Point normalization correctly respects existing stored values or maps standard S/A/B/C/D/E/F grades.
data_quality_findings: No instances of 'Unknown Subject' in the 3-2 dataset due to earlier fixes.
Data structure relies strictly on DB population; missing imports will cleanly trigger the empty state without breaking.
performance_findings: CRITICAL PERFORMANCE BOTTLENECK: The backend /ctpo/results endpoint (ctpoCore.controller.js -> getResults) fetches ALL SemesterResult documents for ALL students in the CTPO's scope for ALL historical semesters in a single query.
Frontend then receives thousands of records and filters them locally: 'const filteredResults = results.filter(r => r.academicSemesterId?.semesterCode === selectedSemester)'.
This will severely degrade performance (high memory overhead and long TTFB) when students have 4-8 semesters of data.
critical_issues: Backend fails to filter results by semester ID/code, pushing the filtering burden entirely to the frontend.
recommended_fixes: Modify ctpoService.getResults and ctpoCore.controller.js to accept and strictly filter by 'semesterCode' so only a single semester's data is transferred to the frontend.
Implement server-side pagination for the Class Results table, or at least projection to minimize payload size.
